items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: He took our pictures, though, and he was supposed to come back, but he never did come back. You know what that is? Little slim fella. Barron Graham.

ctx.x: Somebody's helping him, somebody's helping him.
